evidence.how: the expiry is stamped at the limit itself on a monotonic clock; how soon the screen learns of it is how often it asks (every 0.5 s)

AC-S4-07.1.detail: Scripted and real-clock tests: warnings at their marks, the expiry exactly at the limit, later responses refused with the unsent text kept, and counsel can end early.

evidence.reached_by: label, theory and every anchor's text and ref of the limb; tokens are lower-case runs of letters and digits

AC-S4-07.2.detail: Every limb of the tree is listed with reached / not reached, when it was first reached and the time spent; limbs never reached are named; each debrief statement points at the part of the timeline it comes from. 'Reached' is detected from wording and can miss a point made in other words.

evidence.interruption_source: Missing Links of the matter's argument tree in the scorer's rank order, then its weakest limbs
evidence.wording: built by the host from the scorer's record (label, link, score, threshold, cited inputs)

AC-S4-07.3.detail: Every interruption carries the id of the Missing Link it came from and the inputs it cites; its wording is the host's. Model-worded interruptions through the B-S3-16 prompt path are not built.

AC-3.3.detail: The untimed grounded Mock Court turn is unchanged; a timed response makes no model call, so it adds microseconds, not seconds.
